info.name: ABHICABS API
info.description: ABHICABS cab-booking backend. Set {{baseUrl}}, then run Auth > "Login (admin)" to auto-capture {{token}}. Customer and driver logins capture {{custToken}} and {{driverToken}}. Folders mirror the API reference. Negative tests live in the "Negative / Security" folder.

request.description: Note: /health is NOT under /api/v1. Use {{baseUrl}} without the prefix or hit http://localhost:5000/health directly.
Copy the returned id into {{bookingId}} for the requests below.
Day 14: booking + payments + allocation + invoice + live location in one call.
Use a paymentId that belongs to a DIFFERENT customer than {{custToken}}. Expect 404, not 200.
Use a bookingId owned by a different customer. Expect 404.
Assign the same vehicle to two overlapping bookings; the second returns 409 VEHICLE_UNAVAILABLE.
Send twice with the SAME key and a changed body → 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.
